source_refs.title: Eureka Math / EngageNY, Grade 1, Module 2, Lesson 1

subject: math

objective.text: Add three numbers when two of them make 10. Use this to solve word problems.

explanations.title: Make a ten first
explanations.text: Let's add 9, 1, and 4. First, look for two numbers that make 10. 9 and 1 make 10. Now you have 10 and 4 more. 10 plus 4 equals 14.

explanations.title: Start with the biggest number and count on
explanations.text: You can also start with the biggest number and count on. Start at 9. Count on 1 more. Then count on 4 more.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (ways to add the blocks)

explanations.title: Use the 5 hiding inside the 9
explanations.text: Here is another way to make a ten. The 4 trapezoids and 1 square make 5. The 9 triangles have a 5 inside them. 5 and 5 make 10. 4 triangles are left. 10 plus 4 equals 14.

source_ref.section: Notes on Multiple Means of Representation (4 + 1 = 5 and the 5 triangles inside the 9)

examples.title: 9 plus 1 plus 4
examples.text: There are 9 triangles, 1 square, and 4 trapezoids. 9 plus 1 equals 10. 10 plus 4 equals 14. There are 14 blocks.

examples.title: 1 plus 9 plus 6
examples.text: Bill buys 1 apple, 9 bananas, and 6 pears. 1 and 9 make 10. 10 plus 6 equals 16. Bill buys 16 pieces of fruit.

source_ref.section: Problem Set, item 1 (worked start: 1 and 9 circled as 10)

questions.text: Take 1 out of 5. 1 and what number make 5?
Take 1 out of 3. 1 and what number make 3?
Take 1 out of 10. 1 and what number make 10?
2 plus 8 equals 3 plus what number?

source_ref.section: Fluency: Equal Number Pairs for Ten (suggested numbers 2, 3, 7, 8)

questions.text: There are 9 triangle blocks, 1 square block, and 4 trapezoid blocks. 9 plus 1 plus 4 equals what number?
Look at 9 plus 1 plus 4. Which two numbers make 10?
9 plus 1 makes 10. You have 10 and 4 more. 10 plus 4 equals what number?
Marcus puts 2 pepper slices, 8 carrots, and 6 banana pieces on his tray. How many pieces of food does he have?
Lena makes 4 jump shots, 7 layups, and 3 free throws in basketball. How many baskets does Lena make?
5 upper-grade buddies visit the class. Then 3 more buddies come. Soon after, 5 more buddies come. How many buddies come in all?
Bill buys 1 apple, 9 bananas, and 6 pears. How many pieces of fruit does he buy in all?
Maria gets 4 dolls, 7 balls, and 3 games for her birthday. How many toys does she get?
Maddy catches 8 bugs, 3 frogs, and 2 tadpoles at the pond. How many animals does she catch?
Molly brings 4 red balloons to a party. Kenny brings 2 green balloons. Dara brings 6 blue balloons. How many balloons do they bring?
Toby has 2 dimes. He finds 4 more dimes in his jacket and 8 more on the table. How many dimes does Toby have?
Cindy has 5 cats, 7 goldfish, and 5 dogs. How many pets does she have in all?
Jim sits at a table with 4 teachers and 9 children. How many people are at the table after Jim sits down?
John, Emma, and Alice each have 10 raisins. John eats 3, Emma eats 4, and Alice eats 5. How many raisins does each child have now? Say John, then Emma, then Alice.
The class has 9 triangles, 1 square, and 4 trapezoids. A teacher next door has 4 triangles and 10 squares. Does she have more, fewer, or the same number of blocks? How do you know?
What new way to add did you learn today?
Each child started with 10 raisins and ate some. How did this connect to today's lesson?

hints.text: Take 1 away from the number. How many are left?
First add 2 plus 8. Then think what goes with 3 to make that number.
Look at the numbers. Can you find two that make 10?

You can also start with the biggest number and count on.

assets_required.why_this_method: Exact counts of 9 triangles, 1 square and 4 trapezoids in a 5-group layout. Diffusion cannot count reliably. The square must be able to move.
assets_required.description: A block board. 9 triangles sit in a 5-group layout. A square and 4 trapezoids sit nearby. The square can join the triangles to make a group of 10, and a loop can circle that group.
must_show_exactly: Exactly 9 triangle blocks: 5 in the top row and 4 in the bottom row (source p17)
The loop circles exactly the 9 triangles and the 1 square (10 blocks), not the trapezoids
Next-door bin for q_db_1: exactly 4 triangles and exactly 10 squares
states_or_frames: State 2: 9 triangles, 1 square apart, 4 trapezoids apart
State 3: square in the 10th place, loop around the 10, 4 trapezoids outside
State 4 (q_db_1): bin with 4 triangles and 10 squares
assets_required.interaction: Square can be dragged next to the triangles. The loop then appears around the 10. No typed input inside the widget.
assets_required.alt_text: Nine triangles, one square and four trapezoids, with a loop around ten of them.
assets_required.review_notes: Source blocks are pattern blocks (p17). Check that the loop shows 10 and not 14. Check the next-door bin count of 10 squares.
assets_required.generation_caption: Flat, simple shapes on a plain background: triangles in rows of 5, one square, four trapezoids, no text. Draw a loop around the triangles and the square. [Build by code]

assets_required.why_this_method: Number sentence frame with exact blanks and a marked pair. Anything with exact numbers and interaction is built by code.
assets_required.description: The printed Problem Set frame: three addends, an equals sign and a total, then a second line with 10 plus a number equals a total. The two addends that make 10 can be marked.
must_show_exactly: Three addends shown, matching the question stimulus
A total blank after the equals sign
A second line: 10 plus a blank equals a blank
Exactly two addends can be marked as the pair that makes 10
For q_pr_9 the third addend is Jim = 1
states_or_frames: Frame with the three addends and empty totals
assets_required.interaction: Child marks the two addends that make 10, then fills the totals. The tutor judges only the typed or spoken final answer.
assets_required.alt_text: A number sentence with three numbers added together and a line below that starts with 10 plus.
assets_required.review_notes: Homework item 4 (p25) prints the second line as blank plus blank equals blank, not 10 plus blank. Decide if the widget keeps the 10 plus form.
assets_required.generation_caption: Clean white number sentence frame with three blanks, plus signs, an equals sign and a second line starting with 10, no pictures. [Build by code]
